dedication: JANUS SIT research tribute to Stephen Hawking; algorithmic reverse traversal does not reverse physical time.
goal: Prospectively test whether fixed, non-learned RFI-aware coherent path statistics discriminate artificial weak drifting signals from controlled interference more effectively than strongest matched same-information baselines at a development-frozen false-control budget.

inputs.development: Previously used 0061 ON / 0062 OFF, X-band blc20, strictly threshold calibration only (NOT fresh heldout)
inputs.evaluation: New untouched by SIT2B analysis L-band six-scan cadence 0013–0018, blc21 lowest spectral resolution; one DIFFERENT receiver/cadence, SAME telescope/date/target: not fully independent sky sessions
inputs.original_x_sha_lock: research/seti/janus_sit1_open_result.json:runtime_inputs.hdf5_files, exact SHA256 on dev X files
inputs.new_l_sha_policy: First-seen SHA256 from real public downloaded bytes; on repeated run demand identical SHA256. No published independent source hash claimed.
source_modules: research/seti/janus_sit1_open_3iatlas.py real HDF5 loader and 16×128 deterministic reduction
research/seti/janus_sit2b_temporal_recovery.py 672 full linear track hypotheses and original SIT2B injection scheme
inputs.main_data_scope: Four preregistered nonoverlapping 128-bin chunks per scan, 16 aggregated time bins, authentic measured background; added weak/strong labels are synthetic, not sky observations
inputs.pointing: Archive nominal ON/OFF metadata only, not independent antenna TCS; real ON/OFF pattern insufficient as true ETI truth

equal_information_methods.A_NATIVE_COSMOS_RIDGE: Original R42A8A blind_line_candidate and frozen path ridge, no fit
equal_information_methods.B_STRONG_DIRECT_SIDEBAND: All 672 temporal paths, robust row-MAD center minus two symmetric sidebands
equal_information_methods.C_STRONG_DIRECT_OFF_AWARE: Exact B plus frozen 0.35× time-median OFF nuisance occupancy penalty along path; same physical OFF measurements available to RFI-aware arm
equal_information_methods.D_RFI_AWARE_DIRECT: All 672 paths; per row z=center minus symmetric sidebands; score=median(z)+0.25*mean(clip(z,0,5))-0.30*mean(z<0.2)-0.15*max(std(z)-2,0)-0.35*mean(clip(off_ref_at_path-1.5,0,10)). Optimize all paths, fixed no learning.
equal_information_methods.E_TACHYON_REVERSE_RFI_AWARE: Exactly same D objective and 672 candidate paths/identical OFF mask; process rows in reverse order, use pinned R5F mirror causal provenance C→B→A and independent forward score/bytes replay. Gain over D must be measured, not assumed.
equal_information_methods.strongest_matched_control: max(B,C) on heldout recall subject to false-control budget, NOT combine per-example oracle.

OFF_reference.source: Time-median z values from three untouched, original nominal-OFF scans in SAME receiver and cadence, computed per fixed 128-bin window; source is NOT injection labels and reference is not independently authenticated pointing.

decision_gate.threshold: Separate arm's 95th percentile of X dev NO-injection or artificial-RFI negatives only, method='higher'; freeze before L band eval. No L threshold adaptation, no checkpoint fitting.
decision_gate.positive: In injected weak/strong rows, path within ±2 channel bins in >=12/16 time steps AND arm score strictly above dev-only threshold
decision_gate.negative: No artificial weak/strong overlay; count any above-threshold score on each L eval control as synthetic challenge false positive; these controls can contain genuine unknown sky/RFI signals.
decision_gate.qualified_strong: At least 87/96 strong injected detections; at most 9/192 synthetic controls above threshold; otherwise no scientific sensitivity gain claim
decision_gate.incremental_RFI_aware_gain: At least 10 additional heldout weak injections detected over best qualified B/C full-bank matched filter without more synthetic control exceedances, with strong-positive gate PASS. Never promote on a single dependent L-band cadence.
decision_gate.incremental_TACHYON_specific_gain: At least 10 more heldout weak than identical objective D at equal reference/score information and no more controls; expected 0 for graph-only reverse replay.
